name: obs-triton-metrics-doc
notes: The authoritative Triton metric list. Key finding for LLM work: the core server is request-shaped, not token-shaped. There is nv_inference_first_response_histogram_ms (first response, not first token) but no TTFT, no TPOT, no KV-cache-usage metric - those arrive only if a backend registers them through the custom metrics API.
